description: Source-conditioned photographic era reframing of the verified CR-001 Material-Driven Fashion subject: reinterpret the attached adult fashion photograph as a historically informed Tang-dynasty court-leisure editorial while preserving recognizable facial identity, broad three-quarter standing orientation, weight logic, subject hierarchy, and eye-level full-length framing. semantic_spec.request: Using the attached existing CR-001 Material-Driven Fashion photograph as the sole person-identity and stance reference, produce one new photographic fashion editorial of that same recognizable adult woman reinterpreted in a historically informed Tang-dynasty court-leisure reading. Preserve recognizable facial identity, natural adult anatomical proportions, the broad three-quarter standing orientation and weight-distribution logic, overall subject hierarchy, and eye-level full-length editorial framing in a 4:5 composition. Replace—do not recolor or lightly restyle—the modern champagne-satin architectural evening gown, contemporary low chignon, modern editorial makeup, and warm-gray seamless cyclorama with Tang-informed wardrobe and presentation: a high-waisted long silk skirt with soft columnar volume, layered upper garments with readable construction and calm directional silk sheen, an elaborate upswept Tang-informed hairstyle with restrained gold or silver hair ornament, period-coherent makeup that retains visible natural skin texture, and a quiet timber courtyard or palace-adjacent covered walk with tiled-roof cues under soft architectural daylight. Keep the result clearly photographic and living—not an ink painting, mural, sancai figurine, marble sculpture, ceramic portrait, costume-drama mashup, Song slim beizi default, Qing Manchu court robe, or fantasy xianxia tableau. This is semantic whole-image era reframing guidance for a source-conditioned transform, not a pixel-exact identity lock and not a masked local edit.
